resources.string:
1. Open LSPosed Manager
2. Enable TikMod in the module list
3. Tick TikTok in its scope
4. Tap "Restart TikTok" below
Removes the block on protected screens in TikTok
TikTok will reload the next time you open it
Changes reach TikTok instantly. Only turning a whole feature on or off needs a TikTok restart.
From the post you opened, in the best quality
TikMod card in the share sheet
Shows the smart card on every share
H.264 opens on every device and player; H.265 is smaller and higher quality
What is sent when you pick an app in the share sheet
Videos are sent as a clean MP4, carousels send all photos together, and LIVE stays a link. The card has a button to switch the mode for a single share.
What appears on the TikMod card
Every photo in the carousel, in original quality
Converts HEIC/WebP to a format that opens everywhere
The original sound or the video\'s soundtrack
The frame the creator picked, in full resolution
Link to the clean file, for downloading on a computer
Doesn\'t download a post that\'s already saved
Caption and hashtags to the clipboard on every download
Percent, size, and open or share when done
The list of downloads on this screen
Only the list is removed. The files stay in your gallery.
No downloads yet. In TikTok: Share → TikMod card.
Add a username to get started
\"Only when it starts\" won\'t join a stream that was already running when you enabled watching
\"Time and size\" shows a live notification with a stop button. \"Start and end only\" notifies you when recording starts and when the file is saved.
Checking more often catches the start of a stream sooner; checking less often saves battery
Each recording uses bandwidth and storage. A channel that goes live while the limit is reached starts recording when a slot frees up
Excluded: watching keeps running with the screen off
Recommended: without it Android may pause watching
Recordings are saved as MP4 in your download folder and appear in the download list. You can still record any stream manually from the TikMod card in the share sheet.
A stream that\'s already running, no waiting
Recording runs in the background in TikMod and keeps going even if TikTok is closed. You can record several streams at once.
Add a channel to get started
Live • waiting for a free recording slot
\"After I reply\": read quietly — \"Seen\" is sent to a chat only when you send a message in it. Your own unread counter stays accurate.
The other side won\'t see that you\'re typing
Others don\'t see you as active, and you still see who is
They stay with a small trash sign
A message the other side deleted stays visible
Deleted photos and videos are saved to your gallery
Sponsored videos are removed before they\'re shown
Skips the ad screen when TikTok starts
What not to show in \"For You\"
Hides live streams mixed in between videos
Videos with products and shop links
Filtering happens in the feed list itself, so there are no gaps or empty videos. Changes apply from the next page that loads.
TikMod: restart request sent to TikTok
⚠️ Couldn\'t prepare the file (%1$s) — sending the link
Parallel recording limit reached. You can change it in settings
Not enough free storage to start recording
🔴 Recording @%1$s — keeps going even if you close TikTok
" • saved to your gallery when the stream ends"
Storage almost full — stopping and saving @%1$s
Persistent notification while auto watching is on
When a followed channel goes live and recording starts
Active live recording, with a stop button
⚠️ No video found in this post
🖼️ TikMod: extracting HD cover from the video…
🔴 TikMod: recording started — you can stop it from the notification
❌ Recording of %1$s failed — no video was received from the stream
⚠️ No audio track was received in this stream
⏹️ TikMod: stopping and saving the recording…
♻️ This %1$s was already downloaded — turn off \"Skip duplicates\" to download it again

resources.string: Couldn\'t reach GitHub. Check your connection
Allow TikMod to install updates on the next screen, then tap again
Active recordings are saved and resume automatically after the update
Once a day, when you open TikMod
TikMod and its card inside TikTok follow your phone\'s language: English, Hebrew, Arabic, Chinese, French, Spanish, Russian, German, Portuguese and Turkish.
Start recording any live stream instantly and record several in parallel, with a live panel to stop each one.
TikMod now finds TikTok\'s hidden code by its structure, so features keep working after TikTok updates.
A recording only starts with 1 GB free, and stops and saves safely before storage runs out.
Text is easy to read in dark mode on every screen.
Check for updates, see what changed in every version and update right from TikMod.
The settings app was rebuilt with Material 3, animations and a dashboard.
Follow channels and record them automatically when they go live, even with TikTok closed.
Messages the other side deletes stay visible, marked with a small trash sign.
Send the actual video or photos to WhatsApp and other apps instead of just a link.
\"Seen\" only after you reply, plus hidden typing and online status.
Blocks ads and can hide LIVE, shopping and photo posts in the feed.
Videos you watch aren\'t reported: no view count and no watch history. Recommendations may get less accurate
Saved on this phone only. TikTok isn\'t told anything extra
Nothing yet. Streams you enter in TikTok will show up here
A list of the live streams you entered in TikTok, kept on your phone only. Add a channel to auto-record with one tap.
Your active status is no longer reported to TikTok, and you still see who is active.
Optional: videos you watch aren\'t reported, so they don\'t count as views or enter your watch history.
▶️ @%1$s is still live — continuing the recording
If TikMod restarts in the middle of a recording, it continues into the same file while the channel is still live — one recording, not two.
Removed a hidden region override that made TikTok keep asking for verification in LIVE and blocked subscriptions.
Translated subtitles over any LIVE stream
TikMod listens to the stream, recognizes the speech on your phone and translates it
Remembers the language of each channel and detects it when the phone can
A small line under the translation
Tap to download the speech pack
Android is downloading it in the background
Speech is recognized on the phone. Only the recognized text is sent to Google Translate.
Android\'s speech recognizer requires the microphone permission from the app that uses it. TikMod never opens the microphone: it listens to the stream\'s own audio.
Live captions need Android 13 or newer.
The speech pack for %1$s isn\'t installed. Tap to download.
This phone can\'t recognize %1$s. Tap to choose another language.
Android is downloading the speech pack for %1$s. Captions start when it\'s ready.
The download failed. Tap to try again.
Open TikMod and turn live captions on there to allow them.
This sounds like %1$s. Tap to choose the spoken language.
Speech is recognized by Android on the device, in the languages your phone supports; speech packs download from the app. Needs Android 13 or newer.
The list of streams you entered stayed empty. Fixed, and it now follows swipes from one stream to the next.
Translated subtitles over the LIVE stream you\'re watching, sentence by sentence. Drag them, tap for the quick menu (languages, text size, transcript), hold to hide. Turn them on in the Live screen.
A heavier outline so captions stay readable over bright streams
Don\'t fade them out between sentences
Save the chat of streams you watch to a text file
While you watch a stream, its chat is collected and saved when you leave
On the stream: drag the captions anywhere, pinch to resize, double-tap to pause a line, tap for the quick menu, hold to hide them.
The chat of a stream you watch is saved to a text file when you leave. Turn it on in the Live screen.
Drag the caption bubble anywhere, pinch to resize, double-tap to pause a line. Position and size are remembered.
Background (solid, dim, none), high-contrast text, keep-on-screen, and 1–4 lines.
The screen won\'t dim or lock while TikTok is open
No haptic feedback when tapping around the app
Outside links open in your real browser, not TikTok\'s in-app one
Start videos without sound (turn this off to hear them again)
Hide reposts, creators, keywords and lengths
Filters apply to the For You and Following feeds. Separate words or @names with commas.
Videos reposted into your feed by people you follow
“Suggested accounts” and search cards mixed into the feed
Hide posts by keyword or hashtag, mute creators by @handle, hide reposts, hide suggestion cards, and hide videos that are too short or too long. In the Feed screen.
A playback-speed setting (0.25×–3×), keep videos muted, and keep the screen on while TikTok is open.
Turn off the app\'s haptic vibration, and open outside links in your real browser instead of TikTok\'s in-app one. In Home → General tweaks.
Show a seek bar on all videos so you can scrub them. On by default.
It saved nothing before. Now the chat is captured reliably and saved as one transcript per stream in Download/TikMod when you leave the live.
Adding the chat to the video… %1$d%%
When you record a stream you\'re watching, its comments appear in the video, timed as they were written

Keep TikTok open on the stream while it records — the chat only exists there. After the recording ends, TikMod adds the chat to the video (it takes a moment). A text copy is also saved in Download/TikMod.

Choose how much of your feed shouldn\'t hook you (0–100%), at once or gradually. TikMod learns what grabs you from how long you watch, and shows what it hid and why. Start it in TikMod or from the Quick Settings tile.
Ads that TikTok inserts on the phone are removed too, and paid partnerships are caught more reliably.
The seek bar shows on every video again on TikTok 47.9, short clips included.
No more robot checks in LIVE
Live captions no longer trigger \"Verify you\'re not a robot\" prompts while you watch a LIVE.
Record a stream while you watch it and the comments appear in the video, like in TikTok, each at the moment it was written.
Animated = gifts with a full-screen effect, not small ones like Rose. Shown as banners above the chat, one per combo with its final count.
Will start recording when one of them goes live
Gifts appear as banners above the chat, and their full-screen animations play in the video like in TikTok. Choose all, animated only, or none.
One notification per recording, from recording to saved. A recording you stop stays stopped, even after TikMod restarts.
Take back control of your feed
Choose what TikTok may show you, when it gets stricter, and when it\'s time to sleep.
Applies to new feed pages right away — no restart needed
Posts about these stay. With none selected, the mode just calms the feed (fewer viral and rapid-fire clips).
How much of the off-topic feed is removed: about 40%, about 75%, or all of it.
Turns on by itself at set times
Full strength while you should be sleeping
A calm card over TikTok at bedtime. “5 more minutes” is always possible.
Before bedtime the feed gradually becomes less engaging
After this long in one go, the feed gets stricter by itself
A short break reminder when the limit is reached
Filtering applies to new pages of the For You and Following feeds as they load. Posts that can\'t be read are always kept, and every page keeps at least two posts.
It\'s past your bedtime. The feed will still be here tomorrow.
On until you turn it off
It turned on by itself — change that under “Turn on by itself” below.
Your feed is untouched. Pick how long and it starts at once, from the next videos TikTok loads.
Only posts that match your topics or words. Everything else is hidden.
Your topics always stay, plus about 1 in 4 other posts so the feed still feels natural.
No topics needed: hides viral hits and clips under 15 seconds, the most addictive part of the feed.
No topic chosen yet, so for now it works as a calm feed. Pick a topic or add a word.
Posts about these always stay. TikMod reads the caption, the hashtags and the search words TikTok attaches to each video.
Hiding viral hits and clips under 15 s
Live from TikTok: every post the mode checked, and why it stayed or went.
Nothing yet. Turn it on, open TikTok and scroll — posts show up here within seconds.
%1$d of the last %2$d posts were hidden
kept so the feed doesn\'t stall
Focus hours, bedtime and session limit

Works on new videos as TikTok loads them (every few swipes), in For You and Following. Videos that were already loaded still play. If a whole batch is off-topic, one post stays so the feed doesn\'t stall.
Tip: add the “Stop the addiction” tile to Quick Settings to switch it on from inside TikTok.
🌿 Stop the addiction is on — filtering from the next videos
When on: %1$d%% of the feed won\'t hook you
Right now %1$d%% of the feed won\'t hook you
How much of your feed won\'t hook you
Drag the line. TikMod hides the posts most likely to keep you scrolling until the rest of your feed is this share of “meh”.
Out of every 10 videos: %1$d that won\'t hook you, %2$d of the kind that does
The full mix from the very first video.
Starts like your usual feed and slowly gets less gripping, so you drift off instead of being cut off.

Every post gets an attraction score from 0 to 100. It goes up for things you usually watch to the end (TikMod learns this on the phone), creators you follow, viral posts and very short clips, and down for things you tend to skip. Posts above the middle of your recent feed are the hooking kind; the dial decides how many of them still get through.
Hidden whatever the mix is set to.
Posts about these always get through, whatever the mix.
Hide everything else, whatever the mix.
Pick at least one topic or add a word for this to work.
Posts with these words are always hidden.
How does TikMod know what a post is about?

It reads the caption, the hashtags and the search words TikTok itself attaches to every video (“Search: …” under the video). Longer words also match their plurals and hashtags, and Hebrew prefixes are understood.
Learned on the phone from how long you stay on each post. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Nothing learned yet. Scroll TikTok for a few minutes and come back.
TikMod will start learning what hooks you from scratch.
At bedtime at least %1$d%% of the feed won\'t hook you, and viral hits and short clips go.
After this long in one go, the mix gets stricter by itself.
⏹️ TikMod: stopping @%1$s and saving — the other recordings keep going
Also recording now (%1$d) — tap one to stop it
Live • private account: records as soon as TikTok shows the stream
Not visible on the web — if it\'s a private account you follow, it records when TikTok shows its LIVE
Their stream is only given to TikTok. Tap to open it in TikTok — the recording starts by itself and keeps going when you leave.
The download doesn\'t match the published checksum, so it wasn\'t installed. Try again later.
Private accounts you follow, recorded too

Their stream is only given to TikTok signed in as you. Add them to auto-record: when TikTok shows their LIVE (in the feed, the Following bar or when you open it) the recording starts by itself, and a notification opens the LIVE with one tap.
Stop one recording, keep the others
The record button in a LIVE now stops only that stream. Other streams being recorded are listed under it, each with its own stop button.
Tap the quality next to a channel in the auto-record list to give it its own (Source, 1080p, 720p or 480p). Auto follows the global setting.
One tap in About collects the versions, which hooks went in on the last TikTok start and the recent log, and opens the share sheet. Nothing is sent by itself.

Only TikTok and TikMod can reach TikMod\'s settings and recorder now. Updates are checked against a checksum before they install, the app is smaller, and live captions keep translating on the phone when Google\'s service is unavailable.
Download, archive and watch without being seen
Stories you watch are kept here, even after they\'re deleted
You won\'t appear on the viewer list of stories you watch
You won\'t show up in other people\'s \"Profile views\". You still see who visited you
A copy of every story you watch is kept in TikMod for 30 days. If the creator deletes it, it stays here with a 🗑 mark
To download a story to the gallery: Share → the TikMod card in TikTok, or ⋮ → Save to gallery here
New stories of these channels go to your gallery by themselves
Saved as soon as TikTok shows their stories (the story bar, their profile). Folder: Movies / Pictures › TikMod › Stories
Nothing here yet. Watch a story in TikTok and it shows up here
Every archived story is removed from TikMod. Copies you saved to the gallery stay
A story is marked deleted when TikTok loads that creator\'s stories and one you archived is gone before its 24 hours are up
The TikMod card in a story\'s share sheet downloads it without a watermark. Add channels to auto-save and their new stories go to your gallery by themselves.
Deleted stories stay, with a 🗑 mark
Every story you watch is archived in TikMod for 30 days. When a creator deletes one, it stays in the archive, marked as deleted.
Watch stories and profiles without being seen
Two new switches: stay off a story\'s viewer list, and stay out of \"Profile views\" when you visit someone.
TikTok sends a second, faster play report that slipped through before. It\'s blocked too now.
Every video you scroll to, on this phone only
Every video you watch, searchable. Nothing leaves the phone.
Videos and photo posts from the feed. Ads, stories and LIVE previews are left out.
Nothing yet. Scroll through TikTok and the videos you watch show up here.
Every entry and its cover are removed from TikMod. TikTok\'s own history isn\'t touched.
Kept on this phone only; the newest %1$d are kept.
Tell me when a story gets deleted
A notification when a creator deletes a story you have in the archive

resources.string: Every video you scroll to is kept on the phone: search by name, @handle or caption, open it again in TikTok, and see how long it was on screen.
Know when a story is deleted
When a creator deletes a story you have in the archive, a notification shows it, cover included.
Pick a creator to see only their stories, and how many of them were deleted.
Search the download history and filter it by videos, photos, audio and more.
Nothing yet today. Open TikTok and your day shows up here.
Calmer, deeper and easier to read: new colors and cards, a home screen that shows your day, and a bottom bar with every section.
Archive, auto-save and anonymous viewing, one tap away from anywhere.
A Watch button on every stream being recorded, and on every followed channel that\'s live, opens it in TikTok.
